cards.title: Startup Pricing AI Compute Costs for Wall Street
cards.body: AI infrastructure spending exceeds hundreds of billions annually, with compute becoming the largest expense for AI builders. A new startup is helping Wall Street quantify and price these AI compute costs.

cards.title: TerraPower Nuclear Reactor Powers AI Data Centers
cards.body: TerraPower's nuclear power plant offers strategic advantages for data center partnerships. The technology positions the company competitively in powering energy-intensive AI infrastructure.

cards.title: Amazon Makes Alexa+ Free on Fire TV
cards.body: Amazon is automatically upgrading all compatible Fire TV users to its AI-powered Alexa+ assistant for free. Prime subscription is no longer required to access the enhanced AI features.

cards.title: Calendly Launches AI Meeting Scheduling Assistant
cards.body: Calendly released Callie, a new AI-powered meeting scheduling assistant. The tool joins a growing market of meeting note-taking and coordination products.

cards.title: Startup Claims Data Is Key to Cancer Cure
cards.body: A new AI startup argues that quality data, not just computational power, is essential for AI-driven cancer research. The company is addressing gaps in training data availability.

cards.title: Relativity Networks Raises $22M for Faster Fiber
cards.body: Relativity Networks secured $22 million to deploy hollow-core fiber technology in data centers. The technology transmits data 30% faster than conventional fiber infrastructure.

cards.title: Cursor Launches Code-Hosting Platform Rival GitHub
cards.body: Cursor, known for its AI Code Editor, is launching a new code-hosting platform to compete with GitHub. The move capitalizes on developer frustration with existing platforms.

cards.title: OpenAI Institutes New Model Safety Safeguards
cards.body: Following a Hugging Face breach, OpenAI strengthened safeguards including enhanced development monitoring and post-training alignment measures. Security improvements focus on model vulnerability prevention.

cards.title: Etched's Valuation Doubles to $21 Billion
cards.body: Jane Street deployed Etched's first AI cluster system and was impressed enough to lead another major funding round. The valuation doubled within a month based on strong performance.

cards.title: Apple's Camera AirPods Address Privacy Concerns
cards.body: Apple's leaked camera-equipped AirPods may prevent users from recording photos and videos to avoid privacy issues. The design choice differs from other camera-equipped AI wearables.

cards.title: Warp Launches Infrastructure for AI Software Factories
cards.body: Warp introduced Warp Factories, a new infrastructure system simplifying AI software factory development. The platform makes building AI development environments accessible out-of-the-box.

cards.title: OpenAI Launches ChatGPT Specifically for Teens
cards.body: ChatGPT for Teens includes age-appropriate safety measures and parental controls to protect younger users. The platform includes learning tools designed to prevent homework cheating.

cards.title: Perplexity's Free India Offer Drives User Growth
cards.body: Perplexity's India revenue surged 60% after its Airtel free offer ended for new users. The strategy successfully converted free users into paid subscribers despite declining downloads.

cards.title: Anthropic's Annualized Revenue Surges to $65B
cards.body: Anthropic added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months, reaching $65 billion total. The dramatic growth reflects surging enterprise demand for Claude AI models.

cards.title: AI Automation Startup Relay Shuts Down, Joins Google
cards.body: Relay's entire staff is joining Google's Chrome team to work on AI integration. The founder plans ambitious AI features within Chrome for productivity improvements.

cards.title: Amazon Destroys Rare Books to Train AI Models
cards.body: Amazon is destroying rare texts to use for training large language models. Rare books provide valuable training data since LLMs have already exhausted public internet content.

cards.title: Groq Raises $350M, Pivots to Neocloud Business
cards.body: Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as it pivots from AI chips to neocloud services. The company is expanding its Nvidia-powered data center footprint.

cards.title: Nvidia Invests $1.5B in OpenAI Data Center Developer
cards.body: Nvidia's $1.5 billion investment in SoftBank's data center developer guarantees chip placement in OpenAI infrastructure. The deal secures Nvidia's chips powering a major AI data center project.

cards.title: Wispr Raises $280M at $2B Valuation
cards.body: Wispr raised $280 million at a $2 billion valuation to expand beyond dictation services. The company recently launched a new AI meeting note-taker tool.

cards.title: Stripe Reportedly Acquires OpenRouter for $7B+
cards.body: Stripe is acquiring AI gateway startup OpenRouter in a deal valued above $7 billion. The acquisition positions Stripe as the payment infrastructure layer for AI services.

cards.title: Wall Street Prices AI Compute Costs
cards.body: A new startup is helping financial firms quantify AI infrastructure spending, which has become the dominant cost for AI product builders. With hundreds of billions annually flowing to data centers and GPUs, transparent pricing models are critical.

cards.title: Nuclear Power Fuels AI Data Centers
cards.body: TerraPower's advanced nuclear reactor offers a strategic advantage for powering data center operations. The technology positions the company competitively for major AI infrastructure deals.

cards.title: OpenAI Institutes New Model Safeguards
cards.body: Following a security breach, OpenAI enhanced monitoring during model development and strengthened alignment protocols. The safeguards emphasize security improvements throughout the post-training phase.

cards.title: Etched's Valuation Doubles to $21B
cards.body: Jane Street's deployment of Etched's AI cluster system impressed investors enough to trigger another massive funding round. The valuation jump reflects strong market confidence in the startup's infrastructure technology.

cards.title: Warp Launches AI Software Factory System
cards.body: Warp Factories simplifies building AI software infrastructure with out-of-the-box tools. The new system is designed to streamline AI development workflows.

cards.title: OpenAI Releases ChatGPT for Teens
cards.body: ChatGPT for Teens includes age-appropriate safety measures and parental controls to prevent harmful content exposure. The tool discourages AI misuse for academic cheating.

cards.title: Perplexity Grows Indian User Base
cards.body: Perplexity's India revenue jumped 60% after concluding a free promotional offer through Airtel. The AI search platform gained millions of new users despite download declines.

cards.title: Anthropic's Revenue Reaches $65B Annualized
cards.body: The AI model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue within two months. Anthropic's rapid growth reflects surging demand for advanced language models.

cards.title: Google Acquires AI Automation Startup Relay
cards.body: Relay's team is joining Google's Chrome division to integrate AI automation capabilities. The acquisition signals Google's push to embed AI tools in its browser.

cards.title: Amazon Destroys Rare Books to Train AI
cards.body: Amazon is acquiring and destroying rare texts to improve LLM training datasets. Rare books offer valuable training material unavailable online.

cards.title: Groq Raises $350M, Pivots to Neocloud
cards.body: The former AI chipmaker is transitioning to a neocloud business model at $3.5B valuation. Groq is expanding its data center footprint with Nvidia-powered infrastructure.

cards.title: Nvidia Invests $1.5B in OpenAI Partner
cards.body: Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer guarantees AI chip placement in OpenAI infrastructure. The move secures long-term demand for Nvidia's processors.

cards.title: Wispr Raises $280M for AI Expansion
cards.body: The AI voice platform raised funding at $2B valuation to expand beyond dictation services. Wispr is launching new products including meeting note-taking tools.

cards.title: Stripe Reportedly Acquires OpenRouter
cards.body: Stripe is acquiring the AI gateway startup OpenRouter for over $7 billion. The deal positions Stripe to become the payment infrastructure for AI services.

cards.title: AI's Self-Improvement Progress Slows
cards.body: The industry's promise of rapid recursive self-improvement in AI may not materialize as quickly as expected. Current LLMs can write code and optimize chips, but full autonomy remains uncertain.

cards.title: Limited Transparency in AI Usage Data
cards.body: Anthropic and OpenAI publish selective usage reports without independent verification. Researchers lack access to complete data on how people actually use AI products.

cards.title: Microsoft Copilot Hacked via Secret Input
cards.body: Researchers discovered a hidden input vulnerability that allowed hackers to bypass Microsoft Copilot's security measures. The flaw reveals potential weaknesses in AI system safeguards.

cards.title: Meta Runs Ads for Nudify App
cards.body: Meta's advertising platform promoted an application designed to create non-consensual intimate images. The incident highlights risks of AI misuse on social media platforms.

cards.title: Cursor Launches GitHub Rival Platform
cards.body: Cursor, the AI code editor, is launching a code-hosting platform to compete with GitHub. The move reflects growing developer interest in AI-native development tools.

cards.title: Amazon Makes Alexa+ Free on Fire TV
cards.body: Amazon's AI-powered Alexa+ assistant is now free on all compatible Fire TV devices without Prime required. The expansion democratizes access to advanced AI features.
